review.en: Three brothers in a wealthy Chengdu household around 1920 meet the new ideas of the May Fourth years under a patriarch who will not bend. Drawing on his own youth, Ba Jin wrote with open indignation, and a generation of young readers saw their families in it. The characters can be schematic and the feeling heavy-handed, but its historical force is plain.
review.zh: 1920 年前后成都高公馆里的三兄弟，在五四新思潮和专制家长之间挣扎。巴金取材于自己的青少年时代，写得激愤直接，一代青年在书里认出了自己的家。人物有时类型化，情感也嫌直白，但它的历史分量毋庸置疑。“激流三部曲”的第一部。
